# Dobeu Tech Solutions — llms.txt

> One operator for small fleets. Partnership on the actual job. A product only if the work earns it. Not a faceless ticket mill, and not a brochure site.

## About
- Founder: Jeremy Williams (jeremyw@dobeu.net)
- Based in NYC, building since 2019
- Website: https://dobeu.net
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeremy-williams

## The work
- Sit with the owners and the people on the shift — yards, dispatch, the trucks
- Tailored systems for that fleet, kept in the client's repo
- A product only after the partnership earns it
- RouteReady is an example in the pipeline. It is not generally launched, and this site does not link to it

## Engagement
- 30-minute call about the job, or a short note describing it
- A written scope once the job is clear
- Typical engagement size: $5k–$30k
- A week with the fleet: $1,500, credited if the work continues

## Contact
- Email: jeremyw@dobeu.net
- Portal (existing clients): https://dobeu.net/portal

## Why one person
- You talk to the person doing the work
- The work is learned on the shift, not from a form
- Not a ticket mill
